plan: With a private value of $39, I want to maximize my potential profit. In a first-round auction with no prior history, rational bidders will likely bid strategically near their value. My optimal strategy is to bid slightly below my true value to create a buffer. If others bid aggressively, I might still win, and if they bid conservatively, I'll win with a lower payment. I'll aim to bid around $35-$37 to balance winning probability and potential profit.

My value is $27. In a single-round auction with unknown opponent values, a dominant strategy is to bid close to, but slightly below my true value. Since the prize is awarded to the highest bidder at the second-highest price, I want to maximize potential profit. I'll bid $26.5 - strategically just under my true value to protect against overpaying, but high enough to have a good chance of winning if opponents bid similarly.

My private value is $13. In a first-price sealed bid auction, I want to bid strategically. Since values are randomly drawn between $0-$49, rational bidders will likely bid below their true value.
